derivation: prolonged forms of an obsolete primary (to sink);

occurrences.text: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
